topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: Stepping into the hidden room, I felt the dust rise with my every breath, but it didn’t sour the air. The walls, cramped and whispering secrets, held a promise, a quiet sort of allure. Found a stack of old letters, faded but holding their grip on the past. Maybe they were nothing, maybe just some forgotten love affair or a string of mundane days, but there's always a chance, a glimmer, that they hold a story worth telling. I carefully tucked them into my coat, the paper curling around itself like an old cat settling in. This place was hiding more than just a room; it was hiding stories, and I'm the one who gets to find out what they are.
